notes.title: We are in development
notes.content:
Hi.

After release of Fear the Dark Unknown, we know a lot of players wanted to meet the Beresford family and to know more about the "event" (death of Matilda Beresford in 1824) described in FTDU.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928205/aa2eb924c6e0575f9d42e44da2f6930e27e275af.jpg[/img]

So we are working last months in this horror visual novel to tell you more about Beresford family. Now you can learn more about their stories investigating with Robert Beresford and detective Cooper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928205/09c10fbd6ef8aceb2b1f8fe1f94b05bd2d43be0a.jpg[/img]


Send us your feedback and questions. We are in development ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928205/b2e50ac44c5eb99be67cdeb1139265c1d51bd31a.jpg[/img]
